title: Hinomori Shizuku — Lunch Break Study Session〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'll start pushing now, Shizuku.
One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Airi.
I'll push you next.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Morning, Airi, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Morning.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You gotta hear this!
Yesterday, after school...!!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, that's so sweet of Saki and them...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We all had a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (That explains why Shii came home a little late yesterday. She was hanging out with Minori and her friends...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Minori, Haruka...
Can you tell us more about what you all did?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sure. First, we went to a diner and...
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: Shizuku, the bath's ready.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
Shii, do you have a minute to talk?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sure, what's up...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Nothing serious. I heard about how you hung out with Minori and the others yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, that?
It was all Saki's idea.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I did sorta help pick out our surprise gifts for them...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But other than that, I didn't do much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think you helped plenty.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori had the biggest smile when she was telling us about it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Just listening to her tell that story made us happy too. In fact, our morning practice sort of turned into just us chatting about it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It made you happy...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We... Actually, Airi in particular was very worried about Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Her concern was that Minori and her friends would begin drifting apart since she won't be able to spend as much time with them after switching to the credit-based course...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori seemed pretty worried about that too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know... But she mentioned how you and Kohane gave her the courage to go through with it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, if I were in your position, I'd probably choose the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, I wouldn't be able to see my friends as much, but we don't necessarily have to talk at school and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I may be busy working, but we could always set aside time to meet or hang out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And if going credit-based made it easier for me to make my dream come true, then I'd absolutely choose that option.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We might not be able to have lunch together or talk like this as much...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But your dream is to spread hope to as many people as you can as an idol... I really want that to happen.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: All I did was tell her how I felt...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. That's one of your best qualities, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But are you okay with all this...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Minori's your dear friend, no?
She means a lot to you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you sure you're not going to feel sad or lonely after she makes the switch...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, I will a little...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But Minori has her dream.
I want to give her all the support I can in that, and so does Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, there isn't much point in worrying about us drifting apart when there's no way to know if it'll even happen.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you so much for giving my groupmate the encouragement she needed, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're welcome...
